decisions.reason: The yogurt on mango mousse is award-winning and close to Söbbeke's core cultured dairy range, so it likely sells well and fits retail listings.
The flavoured 'Abendbrotkäse' was prominently promoted as new, but flavoured cheese variants in organic retail rotate fairly often, so there is moderate drop risk.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a staple close to the established offer and is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
A spicy cheese is a niche variant with less certain demand, though it is still likely kept for a while after its 2018 launch.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the new soft cheese line and has broad appeal, so it should stay on the market.
A washed-rind soft cheese is a more specialised taste with a smaller audience, but it remains part of the new line.
